notes.title: 🎮 Dev Roast Round 2: We Took the Hits and Leveled Up 🔥
notes.content:
[h2]🔥 Dev Update — Roast Round Two: We've Applied Your Feedback! 🔥[/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="s0TW5g63Qno;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]A few days ago, we shared an early clip of our Metroidvania project and asked for honest feedback over on [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/metroidvania/comments/1mdgr02/i_applied_your_comments_now_its_time_for_round/" style="button"]Reddit[/url]. The community [i]delivered[/i] — and in true Metroidvania fashion, we went back, explored the weak points, and unlocked some upgrades.[/p][p]Today, we’re excited to show you a new short gameplay clip that reflects many of the improvements you asked for. Animations, lighting, visual clarity — we tackled it all (well, as much as possible for this round!).[/p][p]🎬 [b]\[Watch the updated gameplay clip here!][/b] (insert YouTube or Steam video link)[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔍 What's New in This Clip?[/h3][p]🕹 [b]Better Lighting[/b] — We brightened things up where needed while keeping the mood intact.
🧍‍♂️ [b]Clearer Interactables[/b] — Breakable chests and key objects now have subtle highlight layers.
💥 [b]Improved Effects[/b] — Impact feedback is starting to take shape with particles and subtle shake.
🎨 [b]Style Pass[/b] — Still a WIP, but we’re starting to hone in on a more cohesive visual identity.
🧭 [b]Community-Led Direction[/b] — All thanks to your honest comments and roasts 😅🔥[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🗨 Some Highlights from the Feedback:[/h3][quote][p]“Animations are bricked up like an incel in a room with Sydney Sweeney.”
— @BeardiusMaximus7 (the roast king)[/p][/quote][quote][p]“Lighting improvements look great... Visual style is a bit mixed up — feels medieval and sci-fi at once.”
— Reddit feedback[/p][/quote][quote][p]“Much clearer. Great job. Cohesive, yes — just not screenshot-worthy yet, but that’s fine.”
— @bluestjordan[/p][/quote][hr][/hr][h3]👀 What’s Next?[/h3][p]We're heading into [b]art-focused Discord servers[/b] to dive deeper into visual design and animation. There's still a long road ahead — but every bit of feedback is helping us shape this into something special.[/p][p]If you’ve got thoughts on how it [i]feels[/i] in motion or what stands out (good or bad), drop them below! Or even better — roast away.[/p][p]Thank you for following our dev journey. Your support and feedback mean the world. ❤️[/p][p]— Jumit Games[/p]

notes.title: NEW BOSS! Meet Gorou, the boss you'll hate, and his creator, THEO
notes.content:
[h1]New BOSS out of the oven in our metroidvania indie game: [i]Orin[/i][/h1]

⚡Breaking! We have a brand-new BOSS. We invite you to discover one of our first, most relevant bosses, Gorou and 🥁 the rock star behind the modeling.

[h2]Gorou, our new boss's 3D Model[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506110/d99f11f7ed8dad0f583daf6b14739d483ead0554.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506110/a563b807040b93c089c7a3a63190cd0662c24ac8.png[/img]

[h2]Final render!![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506110/a0575a0692824c18d4abe5e176195285b8751c37.png[/img]

[b]Gorou [/b]is the one who rules at the enigmatic yet beautiful, [b]Shadow Gate Region[/b]. He's the leader of the Dunkels tribe. This tribe is widely distinguished by their ability to manipulate shadows to their convenience. They can camouflage themselves, move silently, and create illusions of light and darkness. So... the next time you feel like something just moved in your room at 3:00 AM, be careful, warrior, could be a Dunkel snicking around by Gorou's orders. [b]BTW, SPOILER: get ready to hate the guy.[/b]

Hopefully that won't happen, as Gorou and the rest of Dunkels' tribe he commands will be rather busy. Wonder why? Well, it turns out Gorou himself stands as a powerful adversary to the main character, our great Orin, leveraging his immense strength and leadership skills to challenge him.

[h2]Jumit Games' Family is Growing[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506110/6f606c3daf1d94982f9cd6704f77722189190c0e.jpg[/img]

Now we got you covered on Gorou, but... who's the star behind this creation? The great [b]Theo[/b], our new [b]3D artist[/b]. Hardworking and passionate, he brings up tons of enthusiasm and smiles to the [b]Jumit Games[/b]' family, that continues to grow! Theo works tirelessly to deliver exceptional art to our project at the time he studies Architecture at college. We are deeply proud of him!

[h2]Your support matters![/h2]

Please do not hesitate to send us [b]feedback [/b]on what you'd like to enjoy with [b]Orin[/b].

Also, keep an eye on the updates. We'll be posting our progress regularly, so also can give us a follow on media channels. We want you all to be part of the journey, the sacrifice and the joy.

[b]P.S. How about an Orin’s art book? Well, it might be coming really soon 😉[/b]

notes.title: Double jump, cannons and more gameplay
notes.content:
[h3]What's new here?[/h3]

[list]
[*]Double Jump Mechanic: Our adventurers can now perform a gravity-defying double jump! This not only adds an extra layer of mobility but also opens up new possibilities for exploring the game world.

[*]Cannons: Prepare for exhilarating moments as we introduce powerful cannons to the game. 

[*]New Level: New designs are coming in + our process for creating levels is improving.

[*]Improved Post-Processing: More understanding of post-processing is also part of this dev-log. Still there is a lot to cover, but looking already better.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=FaEYHJPZb2w;full][/previewyoutube]

Stay tuned for our upcoming updates, which will introduce even more exciting features and content to keep you hooked.

We hope you enjoy these enhancements to our game! Your feedback is invaluable to us, so please keep sharing your thoughts and suggestions. Thank you for being a part of our gaming community as we continue to elevate the adventure together!

Orin's team.

notes.title: First enemies added
notes.content:
[h2]Enemies share common behaviors[/h2]

We are choosing from a range of enemies and implemented the first 3 basic AIs. All the enemies derivate from the same common structure containing:

[list]
[*] Player awareness
[*] Health
[*] Hazard capabilities
[/list]

[h2]Let's make them fly[/h2]

Some enemies are now capable of traversing the map without gravity (flying) using A* algorithm for path finding.

[previewyoutube=kLN3JjLwNBE;full][/previewyoutube]
